summary: Air T Inc. filed an 8-K on June 29, 2026, solely to disclose an updated investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) furnished under Item 7.01 Regulation FD and Item 8.01 Other Events noting a Q&A capability via Slido for its Annual Meeting. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, activist campaign, restructuring, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is a routine current report updating a non-material investor deck. No deal terms, prices, premiums, advisors, or structural mechanics are present. Watch for potential follow-up if the presentation hints at future transactions, but as filed this is a non-event.
